title: Homunculus Fallacy
description: An argument that accounts for a phenomenon in terms of the very phenomenon that it is supposed to explain, which results in an infinite regress.
logical_form:
Phenomenon X needs to be explained.

Reason Y is given.

Reason Y depends on phenomenon X.

examples.example:
Bert: How do eyes project an image to your brain?

Ernie: Think of it as a little guy in your brain watching the movie projected by your eyes.

Bert: Ok, but what is happening in the little guy in your head’s brain?

Ernie: Well, think of it as a little guy in his brain watching a movie...
examples.explanation: This fallacy creates an endless loop that actually explains nothing.  It is fallacious reasoning to accept an explanation that creates this kind of endless loop that lacks any explanatory value.

examples.example:
Dicky: So how do you think life began?

Ralphie: Simple.  Aliens from another planet seeded this planet with life billions of years ago.

Dicky: OK, but how did that alien life form begin?

Ralphie: Simple.  Aliens from another planet seeded that planet with life.
examples.explanation: This fallacy can be tricky because maybe it is true that aliens are responsible for spreading life, so the answers might be technically right, but the question implied is how life *ultimately* began, which this form of reasoning will not answer.

exceptions:
There might be some exceptions that rely on high-level epistemology having to do with a large enough loop and validating feedback.  The important question to ask is, does the explanation have any value and is the question being answered or deflected?

**Fun Fact:** Several fallacies are a result of a lack of explanatory value. For example, the *homunculus fallacy* can be seen as a specific form of the *[failure to elucidate](https://www.logicallyfallacious.com/logicalfallacies/Failure-to-Elucidate)*.
references: Tulving, E. (2000). *Memory, Consciousness, and the Brain: The Tallinn Conference*. Psychology Press.
description_et: Argument, mis seletab nähtust just selle nähtusega, mida see peaks seletama ja mille tulemuseks on lõpmatu taandareng.
logical_form_et:
Fenomen X vajab selgitamist.

Põhjus Y on toodud.

Põhjus Y sõltub nähtusest X.
exceptions_et:
Võib esineda erandeid, mis tuginevad kõrgetasemelisele epistemoloogiale, mis on seotud piisavalt suure ahela ja tagasiside kinnitamisega.  Oluline on küsida, kas selgitusel on mingit väärtust ja kas sellele küsimusele vastatakse või kõrvale kaldutakse?

**Lõbus fakt:** mitmed eksimused tulenevad selgitava väärtuse puudumisest. Näiteks võib *homunculus falacy* olla *[selgitamise ebaõnnestumine](https://www.logicallyfallacious.com/logicalfallacies/Failure-to-Elucidate)* spetsiifilise vormina.

examples_et.example:
Bert: Kuidas projitseerivad silmad pildi teie ajju?

Ernie: Mõelge sellele kui väikesele mehele, kes vaatab teie silmade projitseeritud filmi.

Bert: Ok, aga mis toimub teie peaajus väikeses mehes?

Ernie: Noh, mõelge sellele kui väikesele mehele, kes vaatab filmi...
examples_et.explanation: See eksitus loob lõputu ahela, mis tegelikult ei seleta midagi.  On ekslik arutluskäik nõustuda seletusega, mis loob sellise lõputu ahela, millel puudub igasugune selgitav väärtus.
examples_et.original_example:

Ernie: Think of it as a little guy in your brain watching the movie projected by your eyes.

Bert: Ok, but what is happening in the little guy in your head’s brain?

examples_et.original_explanation: This fallacy creates an endless loop that actually explains nothing.  It is fallacious reasoning to accept an explanation that creates this kind of endless loop that lacks any explanatory value.

examples_et.example:
Dicky: Kuidas sa arvad, kuidas elu algas?

Ralphie: Lihtne.  Tulnukad teiselt planeedilt külvasid sellele planeedile elu miljardeid aastaid tagasi.

Dicky: OK, aga kuidas see võõras eluvorm alguse sai?

Ralphie: Lihtne.  Tulnukad teiselt planeedilt külvasid sellele planeedile elu.
examples_et.explanation: See eksitus võib olla keeruline, sest võib-olla on tõsi, et tulnukad vastutavad elu leviku eest, nii et vastused võivad olla tehniliselt õiged, kuid küsimus on selles, kuidas elu *lõpuks* alguse sai, millele selline arutlusviis ei vasta.
